evidence.claim: Inconsistent notational and boundary conventions for the inner-planet mass cut (Mₚ, M_in, M_P; < vs ≤) appear throughout the Abstract, §3.5, and Figure 5; the strict-vs-inclusive bin cut at 10 M⊕ is consequential for system assignment.
evidence.excerpt: Notational inconsistency for the inner-planet mass cut. The Abstract writes P(CJ|Mₚ > 10 M⊕, …); §3.5 alternates between "Mp", "M_in", and "M_P" within a few lines; Fig. 5 caption uses "M_p"; the closing paragraph ... uses "Mₚ < 10 M⊕" while the bin defined earlier is "Mₚ ≤ 10 M⊕". Beyond the cosmetic issue, the strict-vs-inclusive boundary at 10 M⊕ matters, since planets at exactly 10 M⊕ enter different bins under the two conventions.
